resources.string: Uses true black whenever ChitChat is dark. Saves power on OLED screens.
A native home for your ChitChat community. Start by saving the address of your server.
This is a development build. Not in the app yet: downloading, previewing and sharing files, profile pictures, and guest invite links.
Remove the saved server address from this device.
Your server hosts your conversations. ChitChat messages are not end-to-end encrypted.
Turn on notifications for this phone in Notifications. A UnifiedPush delivery app you choose wakes ChitChat when something arrives; no publisher relay is needed.
Could not read or save your settings. Please try again.
The saved server address was invalid and was not used. Enter your server again.
Use only the server address, without a page path, query, password or fragment.
Sign out or cancel sign-in before changing servers. Resolve any session-clearing warning first.
Your password was accepted, but you are not signed in yet. Native passkeys need a server update. A recovery code is an emergency, single-use fallback; using it consumes one code.
Not in the app yet: downloading, previewing and sharing files, profile pictures, and guest invite links.
Your session is encrypted on this device. Sign in again after seven inactive days or thirty days from sign-in. Your server may expire it earlier.
Server sign-out could not be confirmed. The remote session may remain until it expires; this device has discarded it.
Secure saving could not be confirmed. You may need to sign in again after closing the app.
Saved-session removal could not be confirmed. Retry clearing it before leaving this device.
Secure session storage is unavailable. Reconnect to discard the saved session and try again.
The server certificate could not be verified. Check the address and certificate; verification cannot be bypassed.
The server redirected this API request. Check the server address; credentials were not forwarded.
The server returned an incompatible response. Check that it supports the ChitChat v3.2.1 API.
This session expired or changed. Sign in again.
The request could not be confirmed. Check your connection, then refresh the session before trying again.
Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
The server is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
The username or password is incorrect.
This recovery code is invalid or has already been used.
Session verification changed. Refresh before trying again; the previous request will not be replayed.
Cancel this attempt and start sign-in again before using a recovery code.
This account is banned on this server.
This server requires MFA setup in the browser before this account can sign in.
The server rejected this request. Check your account or contact the server administrator.
This server is in maintenance lockdown. Sign-in may be restricted.
External-provider sign-in needs a native authentication handoff that this server does not yet support.
An account is created on this server, not with the app publisher. The server decides your permissions.
Use 3–32 ASCII letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or number.
Use 12–4096 characters without your username or control characters. The server checks the final password policy.
Birth date is optional. The server uses it for age-restricted rooms.
Preparing the server’s anti-bot check. You can fill in the form meanwhile.
The anti-bot check could not be completed. Refresh it before trying again.
The server requires more time to fill in this form. Refresh the anti-bot check, wait a moment, then submit again.
The server may already have created the account. Try signing in before attempting registration again. The request will not be repeated automatically.
Registration is currently disabled on this server.
That username is already registered. Choose another, or sign in.
The server rejected this birth date. Use a real date within the past 120 years, or leave it blank.

Cancel a scheduled account closure before the server’s cooling-off deadline. This does not reset a forgotten password or restore an account that is permanently closed. Connected-provider restoration needs native handoff support.
The password was accepted. The account remains scheduled for closure until MFA succeeds.
The server confirmed that your account was restored.
This account is scheduled for closure. Choose Restore account before its deadline.
The account is permanently closed or its restoration deadline has passed.
This account is not scheduled for closure. Use sign-in instead.
This is a guest session. Guest features are not included in this slice; ending the visit is permanent.

Export the retained data the server associates with your account, including your messages, visible direct messages, profile, submitted reports and account activity. File attachments are metadata only; the profile picture is included where available. The server controls retention and authorization.

The saved JSON is not encrypted. Your chosen documents provider may upload it to cloud storage. Anyone with access to that file can read it; signing out of ChitChat does not remove it. Choose a private location.
Choose a new file first. Cancelling or a network/storage failure can leave an empty or incomplete file; remove it yourself. Nothing is downloaded to an app-owned disk cache.
Choose where to save the JSON file.
Your export was saved to the location you chose.
Export cancelled. A chosen file may be empty or incomplete.
No document picker is available. Install or enable a documents provider.
The file could not be saved. Check the selected location and its permissions. It may contain an incomplete export.
This export exceeds the app’s 16 MiB response limit. Use the server’s browser client for this account. No partial export was saved by this request.
The network request failed and will not be repeated automatically. Refresh the session before trying again. A chosen file may be empty or incomplete.
Re-enter your current password. The server grants sensitive actions for a short time in this session. Only this requested action will be retried, once, after successful verification.

This account requires a passkey or emergency recovery code. Native passkeys need server support and are not available in this version. You can instead complete the action in the server’s browser client, using its separate sign-in session.

This account has no password. Native provider confirmation needs server handoff support and is not available in this version. Complete the action in the server’s browser client; browser authentication will not be copied into the app.

This is an emergency fallback, not routine passkey verification. One unused recovery code is consumed immediately, even if the export later fails or is cancelled. Codes are finite. Continue only if you intend to spend one.
The recovery request may have consumed that code. It was not repeated. Refresh security information before using another code.
The server did not accept the action after verification. It will not be retried again. Start a new export only when ready to verify again.
This room isn’t available any more. Your message wasn’t sent.
This room isn’t available any more. Your file wasn’t sent.
You can still read what’s here. Sending needs a connection.
The certificate couldn’t be verified; this can’t be bypassed.
Live updates are off; use Refresh to update.
Use Refresh to update, or try again.
Try again in a little while.
Try again in less than a minute.
This may be out of date. Refresh to update it.
Your previous position was removed from retained history. Showing the nearest available message.
No messages remain in this range. Jump to latest to check for newer messages.
New messages available — jump to latest
This history range could not be synchronized within the app’s bounded window. Your position and draft were kept. Refresh to retry or jump to the latest messages.
Room activity is paused. Enter the room to appear online and send messages.
Active room presence ended due to inactivity. Your draft and loaded history were kept.
Active room presence is unavailable. Refresh permissions or enter the room again.
Room presence will end soon due to inactivity.
The online list is updating or unavailable.

This account setting applies across your devices, in rooms and direct messages. When off, others cannot see when you type, and you cannot see when they type. Typing signals never include your message text.
Native typing indicators work only while you view an eligible foreground conversation. Only your identity is signalled, never the text you type.
Show when I type and when others type
The server preference is not confirmed. Refresh it or explicitly choose a setting; unknown does not mean enabled.
The change was not confirmed and will not be retried automatically. Refresh before trying again.

Drafts stay only in this app’s memory for this account and server. Signing out or closing the app process clears them. Discard removes local text only; it cannot retract a message already accepted by the server.
Delivery was not confirmed. Check the room history explicitly before choosing another send.
There are 100 saved room drafts. Open Saved room drafts and discard one before composing in another room. Nothing was evicted.

A private choice across rooms on this server. Their room messages collapse and their room mentions and pings stop notifying you. They are not told. Direct messages are unaffected; blocking is separate.
The ignore list is not confirmed. Refresh it before making a change.
The change was not confirmed. It will not be retried automatically. Refresh the session to check the server before trying again.
Cancelling may leave the change applied on the server. Refresh before another attempt.
This account is no longer available. Refresh the session to check your ignore list.
The original message is no longer available, or you do not have access. Your draft is kept.
Could not load the original message. Check your connection and try again. Your draft is kept.
This server did not provide the information required to open the original message safely.
Refresh the session before opening this message. Your draft is kept.
Waiting for the current conversation operation to finish…
The server asked us to wait before retrying. Your draft is kept.
Reading a notification is separate from reading a chat. Opening this list does not mark anything as read.
The read request was not confirmed and will not be repeated automatically. Refresh notifications to check the server before making a new read choice.
This range could not be fully checked. Refresh or explicitly jump to the latest notifications; unrelated ranges have not been combined.
These notifications may be out of date. Refresh before changing read state.
Showing an older window. Refresh keeps this range; Latest returns to new notifications.
No notifications remain in this older range. Use Latest to check new notifications.
This includes notifications not loaded here and any that arrive before the server processes your request. It does not mark room or direct-message chats as read.
Could not check notifications. Check your connection, then refresh. Any read request will not be repeated automatically.
Opening this notification’s destination is not yet available in this app.
This destination is not supported in the native app. No browser or external link has been opened.
Only the latest 100 private pings are available. Opening a ping does not read the room conversation.
The requested private ping is not available here. Only the latest 100 private pings can be searched; it may also have expired or been hidden by your ignore preferences.
This message changed or is no longer available in this view. Close this menu and select it again.
Reply is unavailable while messaging is disabled or saved drafts are full.
Choose a link to open it in another app. Tap a message to find its links here.
Could not open the link. You can copy the message instead.
The original is not visible in this view. You can open it or remove this reply.
The original is hidden by your ignore settings.
The original is no longer available for this reply. Refresh before retrying. Choose another message or remove the reply; your text is kept.
Private pings do not quote messages. This selection will be cleared after the ping is sent.
Edits and deletion affect everyone with access. Revisions and files may remain under the server’s retention policy; this does not erase retained history or copies.
This action is currently unavailable. Wait for the current operation or refresh the session before trying again.
A change to message %1$s could not be confirmed. It may already have happened. Check history before choosing another edit or deletion; nothing will be repeated automatically.
100 rooms have unconfirmed message changes. Check their histories before changing messages in another room.
History checked. Review the current message before choosing a new action.

Your proposed text stays here while you check history and review a fresh choice. Closing or backgrounding discards it; the warning stays in memory for this account. Nothing here survives process death.
This message is no longer editable in this view. Your proposed text is kept here until you close.
Choose Add or Remove for your own reaction. Counts include everyone who reacted.
The reaction change to message %1$s may have succeeded. Check history before making another choice.
Review the current reactions before making a fresh choice.
This message was deleted. Reaction counts and names can remain. You can remove an existing reaction of your own.
Too many unconfirmed reaction changes. Check history in a room with an unconfirmed change before changing another reaction.
History checked. Review the current reactions before choosing again.
Too many unconfirmed reaction changes. Open a conversation with an unconfirmed change and check its history before changing another reaction.
DM privacy information is unavailable. Refresh the session to reload it, or choose Rooms in search options.
Use 2–200 characters after whitespace normalization, including a letter or number. Very long input is rejected rather than shortened.
Input is too long. Shorten it before searching; the previous input has been retained.
Opening the original message is not available yet.
Opening checks current access to the exact original message. It does not mark newer chat messages read.
Some results are no longer accessible and have been removed. Choose Search to check current access again.
No accessible results remain on this page. Choose Search to check access again.
Enter terms and choose Search. Search does not mark messages or notifications as read.
Results are ordered by relevance. Messages can move between pages as they change.
No visible messages matched this search.
The search page limit has been reached. Refine your terms to find more specific results.
Use 2–200 characters after whitespace normalization, including at least one letter or number.
Too many requests. Please wait, then choose Search or Retry.
The session needs attention before searching. Open search options to refresh it.
The server returned unavailable or incompatible search or privacy information. Refresh the session before trying again.
Search could not be completed. Review your input before choosing Search or Retry.
Basic profile details. Profile pictures and account actions are not available here yet.
This profile is no longer available to this session.
The profile could not be loaded. Check your connection, then refresh.
Could not load suggestions. Your draft is safe. Refresh suggestions to try again.
No matching names. Keep typing to change the search.
Attach, not available on this server
The app couldn’t read %1$s’s file settings, so sending files is off for now.
If this keeps happening, tell the person who runs %1$s.
The app couldn’t read this server’s file settings, so sending files is off for now.
Your server allows %1$s %2$s, refused ones included.
Couldn’t remove the location from this photo.
The app can’t remove location from this kind of photo, so it may show where it was taken.
This file can’t be read. Choose it again, or pick another.
This file is too large for this phone to prepare for sending. Try a smaller file.
This file is %1$s. This server accepts files up to %2$s.
This server doesn’t accept this type of file.
Attaching the file when the room is ready…
The file wasn’t attached. Choose it again.
Captions can be up to 4,000 characters.
Your server refused this file: it’s larger than the %1$s it accepts.
Your server refused this file: it’s too large.
This file type isn’t allowed on this server.
Your server refused this file because it’s empty.
You’ve reached the upload limit. Try again in %1$s.
You’ve reached the upload limit. Try again later.
Your server didn’t accept this file. Nothing was sent.
Couldn’t send the file. Check your connection, then send again.
This server’s file settings changed, so this file can’t be sent as it is.
Looking for your file in this room…
We found your file “%1$s” sent at %2$s. Is this it?
We couldn’t find it in recent messages. It may still have arrived. Sending again may post it twice.
Recent messages couldn’t be loaded, so it’s still not known whether your file arrived.
You can’t send files to this person right now. Nothing was sent.
Turning on: waiting for your delivery app
Needs setup: notifications for this phone may have stopped.
Needs setup: not sure this phone is registered. Your server’s answer didn’t arrive.
Needs setup: no delivery app found
This delivery address is already used by another account. Choose a different delivery app or remove it there first.
Your account already has 20 devices with notifications. Remove one below, then try again.
Your delivery app’s server couldn’t be reached. Try again in a moment.
This delivery app’s address can’t be used with %1$s. If it runs on a private network, the person who runs %1$s has to allow it.
Your server didn’t accept this phone.
Needs setup: your delivery app couldn’t connect.
Needs setup: your delivery app needs your attention. Open it, then turn on again.
Needs setup: your delivery app couldn’t set this up.
Your server doesn’t offer notifications for this phone.
Couldn’t start turning on notifications. Try again.
Turned off on this phone. Your server didn’t confirm the removal, so this phone may still be listed under Devices. You can remove it there.
On the lock screen, ChitChat shows only that something arrived, unless your phone is set to show all notification content.
ChitChat doesn’t run in the background. A delivery app you choose wakes it when something arrives, which saves battery.
ChitChat needs a UnifiedPush delivery app to receive notifications. Install one, then come back and turn on notifications.
ChitChat can use Google’s Firebase Cloud Messaging instead. Your notifications stay encrypted: Google can’t read them, but it sees when this phone gets one.
How to choose a delivery app
ChitChat is built with these open-source projects. Tap one to see its licence.
A delivery app is installed now. Turn on again to use it instead of Google.
Your last change couldn’t be confirmed. Refresh to see what’s saved before changing anything else.
When someone writes to you directly. The alert shows who it’s from, never what they wrote.
You’ll only get alerts for new messages from now on.
Account, security and moderation notices always arrive while notifications are on.
Enter a time zone such as Europe/Berlin.
Quiet hours are applied by your server, on all your devices.
Alerts during quiet hours aren’t sent later. You’ll find them in Activity.
Notifications usually arrive within seconds, sometimes a little longer, and later if your phone was offline. Some never arrive. Open the app to see everything.
No devices receive notifications for this account.
Turn off notifications for this phone?
It stops receiving notifications for this account.
Couldn’t reach your server. Your previous choice is kept.
Your server didn’t accept that choice. Your previous choice is kept.
Couldn’t save that change. Your previous choice is kept.
